Distance Color Blending, also known as Intensity Depth-Cuing, is a well-known technique for enhancing the perception of depth in a scene, originally described in computer graphics literature [Foley96, cited in S5].

The final color is calculated as $sI + (1 - s)I_{bg}$, which is a linear interpolation between the object's intensity and the background intensity. Thus, all facts in the claim are present and supported by the evidence.
